name: ~Shinsei Kishi Ryoujoku~
source:
There were many countries on Meautliana continent. Hundreds years of war across the continent. A new religion was born as people wished world peace, and it was not long before they ruled the world.

A hentai adventure game of three holy knights. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030290.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
莫特利亚纳大陆上有许多国家。整个大陆数百年的战争。在人们祈求世界和平的同时，一种新的宗教诞生了，不久他们就统治了世界。

三位圣骑士的无尽冒险游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030290.html]DLsite English[/url]]
